seo.title: All-inclusive coworking and offices in Besançon
seo.description: Private offices and dedicated desks in central Besançon. Bills, fibre, cleaning, meeting room and coffee included. Two addresses: Carnot and Granvelle.

hero.text: Private offices and dedicated desks in central Besançon. Sign, drop your things, get to work. Bills, fibre, cleaning, meeting room and coffee are all in.

items.title: You visit
items.text: 20 minutes on site, coffee included. We show you both spaces and the free desks.

items.title: You sign
items.text: A simple service contract, no commercial lease, no admin fees.

items.title: You work
items.text: Badge handed over, fibre plugged in, coffee hot. You can move in within 48 h.

items.q: What is really included in the price?
items.a: Bills, water, electricity, heating, cleaning, high-speed fibre, furniture, meeting room, fitted kitchen and coffee. There are no additional fees.
Of course. Carnot has a meeting room with a projector; Granvelle has a bar area and a sofa corner for informal meetings.
